name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: One choice from a long list, typed to filter, on Base UI's Combobox: an input in an Input-like frame with clear and open buttons, and a popup of filtered items, groups, a no-results line and a status line, in three sizes.
usage: Use Combobox when the user picks one value from a list too long to scan (tables, roles, time zones) or knows what to type. Put it in a Field after a FieldLabel, pass items (strings, { value, label } objects, groups of { value, items }, or a Combobox.createItems collection to store ids) and a function child that renders each item as a ComboboxItem; Base UI filters by label as the user types and the first match is highlighted, so Enter takes it. Show loading or an error of an async search with status, and say what was searched for with emptyMessage. With TanStack Form wire value, onValueChange and onOpenChange (blur on close) to the field. For a short fixed list use Select; for several values, MultiSelect; for free text with suggestions, an Input.

props.name: items
props.description: The items to filter and list; the function child renders each one.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled chosen value; null when nothing is chosen.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when the user chooses or clears.

props.name: inputValue
props.description: Controlled text of the input (with onInputValueChange), for an async search.

props.name: filter
props.description: Custom matching; null keeps every item (the server already filtered).

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder of the input, in color.fg.subtle.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Shown when no item matches the text.

props.name: status
props.description: A polite live line above the items (loading, an error); nothing when empty.

props.name: autoHighlight
props.description: Highlight the first match while filtering, so Enter takes it.

props.name: size
props.description: Frame height from size.control.*, which follows data-density.

props.name: name
props.description: The form field name of the hidden input; a Field's name wins.

props.name: required
props.description: A value must be chosen before the form submits.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Ignores interaction; a Field's disabled sets it too.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Focusable but the value cannot change.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when there is no FieldLabel.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the frame, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: frame
slots.description: The Input-like frame, role="group"; data-slot="combobox", data-size and data-popup-open name it.

slots.name: input
slots.description: role="combobox" with aria-autocomplete="list"; data-slot="combobox-input". A hidden <input> follows the frame for forms.

slots.name: clear
slots.description: Clears the value, shown while there is one; data-slot="combobox-clear" and data-visible.

slots.name: trigger
slots.description: The chevron that opens the list, out of the tab order; data-slot="combobox-trigger".

slots.name: positioner
slots.description: In a portal at the end of <body>, at z.dropdown, with the frame's data-theme and data-density; data-slot="combobox-positioner".

parts.name: ComboboxItem
parts.description: One item, role="option": its content, and a check mark while chosen; color.interactive.hover while highlighted.

parts.name: ComboboxGroup
parts.description: A group of items, role="group", named by its ComboboxGroupLabel; render its items in a ComboboxCollection.

parts.name: ComboboxGroupLabel
parts.description: A group's heading in type.caption and color.fg.subtle.

parts.name: ComboboxSeparator
parts.description: A 1 px line in color.border.default between items or groups.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus in the input: a ring of ring.width in color.ring around the frame.

states.name: open
states.description: While the popup is open the frame border is color.border.focus.

states.name: entering
states.description: The popup fades in over motion.duration.fast with motion.easing.enter, and out with motion.easing.exit.

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer over the clear or chevron button: color.interactive.hover.

states.name: highlighted
states.description: The item under the pointer or the keyboard: color.interactive.hover.

states.name: no value
states.description: The clear button is hidden while there is nothing to clear.

states.name: invalid
states.description: In an invalid Field, or with aria-invalid: color.status.danger.border borders.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Ignores interaction, at opacity.disabled, with the clear button hidden; a disabled item is color.fg.disabled.

accessibility: The input is role="combobox" with aria-autocomplete="list", aria-expanded and aria-controls, named by its FieldLabel (aria-labelledby) or aria-label; the popup is a role="listbox" of role="option" items with aria-selected, in role="group"s named by their labels.
Typing filters and opens the list; ArrowDown and ArrowUp move the highlight while focus stays in the input (aria-activedescendant), Enter chooses, Escape closes and then clears, and Tab leaves.
The chevron button is out of the tab order and hidden from assistive technology, as the input already opens the list; the clear button is reachable by pointer and is named by clearLabel.
The status line is aria-live="polite", so loading and errors of an async search are announced without moving focus; the no-results line is announced the same way.
The chosen item shows a check mark, so the state does not rest on colour; the frame border is color.border.strong (3:1 against the surface).
The popup takes the frame's theme and density even when they are set on a region rather than <html>.
